lines: Try not to blink next time, {player}.
That makes the score {villager_wins} to {villager_losses}. Not that I am counting.
You brought courage. I brought results.
A fine attempt, {player}. Almost convincing.
The whole village saw that one.
I could offer lessons, but they would cost extra.
Still feeling gutsy, {player}?
I won the wager and the bragging rights.
You move well?for someone I just beat.
Remember this score: {villager_wins} wins for me, {villager_losses} for you.
That arena suited me nicely.
No hard feelings. Just a very clear winner.
I expected a challenge and received a warm-up.
Tell your friends I fought bravely. Tell them I won, too.
Whenever you are ready for another lesson, wait out the cooldown.
You won. There, I said it.
Do not look so pleased with yourself, {player}.
The score is {villager_wins} to {villager_losses}. I can still turn it around.
I had you exactly where I wanted you. Briefly.
The sun was in my eyes. Somehow.
Enjoy the wager. I will earn it back.
I have fought better days.
Everyone saw that, did they? Wonderful.
Next time I am bringing a better plan.
A loss is practice wearing an ugly hat.
You were faster than I expected, {player}.
I am not sulking. I am reviewing tactics.
One bout does not settle everything.
Fine work. Do not make me compliment you twice.
I will remember that strike. Mostly because it still hurts.
